purpose: Define supported UI language profiles and deterministic fallback behavior while keeping commands and internal identifiers language-invariant.

topics.name: Localization Language Profile
topics.purpose: Define supported UI language profiles and deterministic fallback behavior while keeping commands and internal identifiers language-invariant.

semantics.language_rule: UI language is explicit per applicable user/session/site context.
semantics.fallback_rule: Fallback chain is explicit and deterministic.
semantics.identifier_rule: Canonical/internal identifiers and command names remain language-invariant English/ASCII according to their owning contracts.
semantics.coverage_rule: Translation coverage can be measured per language/profile.
semantics.missing_rule: Missing translation uses fallback rather than inventing localized semantics.
semantics.format_rule: Locale-sensitive display formatting is presentation only unless a data schema explicitly defines locale semantics.

invariants.rule: Localized labels are context-bearing presentation resources mapped to stable canonical identities; translation never changes command names, internal identifiers or semantic identity.

hard_gates.condition: locale display formatting mutates canonical stored value
unsupported language silently treated as fully translated
